app.title: DEXP GS Slayer Pro — charging dock
status.not_found: Dock not found. Connect it to the computer with the cable.

tray.title: DEXP GS Slayer Pro — dock
tray.autostart_on: Autostart is on: the program starts with Windows in the tray
screen.auto_sync: Sync automatically (on connect and every minute)
screen.synced_sent: Time sent ({time}). The dock did not reply — check the screen.
screen.note: The vendor app does not implement picture upload or screen brightness: those buttons are empty stubs and their protocol is unknown. This tool offers what the dock actually supports: the clock.
light.dpi_follow: Dock lighting follows the mouse DPI
light.dpi_follow_hint: The dock shows a static colour of the current DPI level, the same one the indicator above the mouse wheel and the GS Slayer app show. The number of levels and their colours are read from the mouse itself, so edits made in GS Slayer show up on the dock at once. Brightness comes from the slider above. GS Slayer can stay open. Turning this off puts the previous lighting back. While the mouse sleeps the colour does not change: move it or press the DPI button.
light.dpi_waiting: Waiting for the mouse… (move it or press DPI)
light.dpi_wait_dock: The mode starts when the dock is connected
light.dpi_stopped: DPI colour mode is off, the previous lighting is back
common.read_ok: Current settings read from the dock
indicator.hint: What the dock indicator LEDs show.
error.timeout: The dock did not answer. Check the cable and that the mouse is on the dock.
cli.dpi_follow_started: Dock lighting follows the mouse DPI. Ctrl+C to quit (the previous lighting comes back).
cli.daemon_started: Watching the dock, syncing time every {interval} s. Ctrl+C to quit.
probe.intro: Watch the dock screen. 6 variants of the clock command will be sent one by one with a {pause} s pause after each. Note after which number the screen time changed.
probe.sent: Variant {number}: sent; if it is the right one the screen shows {time}. Dock reply: {reply}
probe.outro: Done. What time does the dock screen show now and after which variant did it change? Restore the correct time with: py -3 -m dexp_dock sync-time (once the working variant is known).
check.unsupported: the dock reports this function as unsupported
indicator.unsupported: This dock does not support indicator settings
check.hang: The check hung for more than {seconds} s — the stuck location was written to the log.
check.look_at_screen: Look at the dock screen: it should show {time}.
